title: New GTA 6 'Dog Poop' Gameplay, Images, And Extra Info To Hype You Up
summary: South Park has the latest GTA 6 'poop-scoop'
text: New GTA 6 'Dog Poop' Gameplay, Images, And Extra Info To Hype You Up | Pure Xbox Menu Search Share Guest Guest Login | Sign Up Pure Xbox News Reviews Features Games Guides Videos Forums Search Keywords Guest Login or Sign Up Home Choose Topics... Manage Topics News Xbox GTA 6 Rockstar Games South Park Screenshots Gallery Xbox Series X Xbox Series S New GTA 6 'Dog Poop' Gameplay, Images, And Extra Info To Hype You Up South Park has the latest GTA 6 'poop-scoop' by Craig Reid 7 hours ago Share: It's been 1,059 days since we first caught a glimpse of GTA 6 , and in just a mere few weeks, we'll be able to play it on Xbox Series X|S. Just MERE weeks, people! The game looks great, but if you're unsure whether or not to pick it up for yourself, maybe throwing and slapping NPCs with dog poop with seal the deal. We're really talking about dog poop here. Would you expect anything different from South Park , which somehow teased exclusive new footage of Jason hurling dog-turd missiles at unsuspecting beachgoers? Take a look: New gameplay from GTA 6 was shown in the latest ‘SOUTH PARK’ episode. pic.twitter.com/gL2kRKUv2I - DiscussingFilm (@DiscussingFilm) October 29, 2026 That's the stuff, it's dog poop alright. But all jokes aside, there's a tonne of new GTA 6 screenshots to drool over, if that's your kink. So, here's a look at the screenshot gallery below: There's also a whole host of new details circulating out there, and thanks to our lovely sister site, Push Square , we've got a summary of them for you to check out: The overall map is roughly the same size as GTA 4, GTA 5, and Red Dead Redemption 2 combined Red Dead Redemption 2 has heavily impacted the narrative There are fully functioning train and bus systems in the game There's a smell mechanic and characters can react to foul ones NPCs act differently depending on the region of the map you're in You can switch between playing as Jason and Lucia at any time The relationship between Jason and Lucia is measured on a four-point scale You increase it by spending time together You can call a car to your location through the Scooter Bros app on your phone The entire arsenal of weapons you have access to is stored in the boot / trunk of your car Every car has a fuel gauge and engine health, and refilling the tank is easy K9 dog units are part of the police system Grand Theft Auto 6 is hitting Xbox Series consoles on November 19 and still we're yet to see anything captured on Xbox. Maybe one day soon, but if not, it's only a few weeks to wait. Related Articles News Xbox Racks Up Millions Of Views Teasing GTA 6 On Xbox Series X You're not playing GTA 6 are you?
